card: ROLE: Prophesied being; the designated endpoint of a Shabda-Oud twelve-generation breeding plan intended to reshape galactic power.
TRAIT: Not yet born; known only as a prophesied future being and breeding objective.
TRAIT: Designed to be hermaphroditic — the product of deliberate genetic selection across twelve generations of Shabda-Oud planning.
TRAIT: Prophesied to dethrone the galactic empress and deliver absolute power to the Shabda-Oud order.
RELATIONSHIP: janus-jana (Janus-Jana): Sama-Wajd is prophesied to usurp and overthrow her galactic rule.
RELATIONSHIP: oda__princess (Oda Capricious): The Shabda-Oud designate her womb as the required vessel for Sama-Wajd's conception.
RELATIONSHIP: jejoh (Jejoh): Named as the required sperm donor in the Shabda-Oud reproductive ritual; designated genetic father.
VOICE: No attested speech, interiority, or act of will; do not voice Sama-Wajd as an acting person yet.
INSTRUCTION: Treat Sama-Wajd as an abstraction — a prophecy and a goal — not an agent with plans, will, or independent perspective.
BOUNDARY: All known claims about Sama-Wajd are mediated through Shabda-Oud prophecy and agenda; no independent perspective, history, or agency is established.

manual_review_notes: Source is thin but sufficient for a useful bounded card: Sama-Wajd is unborn, prophesied, and defined only through the Shabda-Oud breeding plan and its intended relationship to Janus-Jana, Oda, and Jejoh.
